allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Hector is a quirky psychiatrist who has become increasingly tired of his humdrum life. As he tells his girlfriend, Clara, he feels like a fraud: he hasn’t really tasted life, and yet he’s offering advice to patients who are just not getting any happier. So Hector decides to break out of his deluded and routine driven life. Armed with buckets of courage and child-like curiosity, he embarks on a global quest in hopes of uncovering the elusive secret formula for true happiness. And so begins a larger than life adventure with riotously funny results.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can a sheltered therapist truly diagnose contentment without first surviving the messy chaos of the wider world?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Feeling like an impostor whose patients never actually improve, quirky psychiatrist Hector leaves behind his comfortable routine and girlfriend Clara to wander the globe in pursuit of what makes people genuinely happy.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A warm, lighthearted quest that pairs comedic globe-trotting with thoughtful, low-stress reflection.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Peter Chelsom turns personal burnout into a scenic, open-hearted comedy that balances gentle philosophical questions with breezy, far-flung misadventures.
